entries.first_pass_kannada: ಅದಿತಿಯ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಪುತ್ರರು ಮಹಾಸುರರು: ಮಹಾಬಲಿಷ್ಠ ಹಿರಣ್ಯಕಶಿಪು ಮತ್ತು ಹಿರಣ್ಯಾಕ್ಷ. ಹಿರಣ್ಯಾಕ್ಷನನ್ನು ಹಿಂದೆ ವಿಷ್ಣು ಮಾಯೆಯಿಂದ ಕೊಂದನು. ⟦ಅಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ⟧.

first_reference_review.receipt:
partial
0771, folio 1: line begins after 14 with the pair and ends on next line after मायया परौ before 16; native crop confirms परौ. Dual likely modifies the two great asuras, not the singular act of killing. The joined wording at the start does not safely settle Diti/Aditi as lexical transcription; 16 and 18 explicitly portray Diti mourning and calling them her sons. Do not change the first-pass name into a settled claim from this alone; preserve both this ambiguity and the अन्वय question for the dual. Transcription lines 66–77 agree on परौ and show the same narrative contrast.
Kannada candidate: ⟦ಅಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ⟧ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಪುತ್ರರು ಮಹಾಸುರರು: ಮಹಾಬಲಿಷ್ಠ ಹಿರಣ್ಯಕಶಿಪು ಮತ್ತು ಹಿರಣ್ಯಾಕ್ಷ. ಹಿರಣ್ಯಾಕ್ಷನನ್ನು ಹಿಂದೆ ವಿಷ್ಣು ಮಾಯೆಯಿಂದ ಕೊಂದನು. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ‘ಪರೌ’ ಎಂಬ ಪದ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಸಹೋದರರನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುವ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆಯಿದೆ; ಅದರ ನಿಖರ ಅನ್ವಯ ⟦ಅಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ⟧.

contextual_rechecks.receipt:
partial
[Bhāgavata 6.18.11](https://vedabase.io/en/library/sb/6/18/11/) explicitly calls the pair Diti's sons, and [6.18.37](https://vedabase.io/en/library/sb/6/18/37/) puts the death of her two sons in Diti's mouth during the same boon narrative. [Likely Desai Marathi 7.1.15–18](https://www.transliteral.org/pages/z120204214828/view) does the same, aligning both sides of the potential editorial boundary. K7.1.14 and .16–18 already identify Diti as speaker and mother narratively, so the intended mother is clear. But digitally printed महासुरौऽदितेः and the native receipt's uncertain word boundary cannot be silently regularized; the final dual परौ grammatically cannot modify singular हिरण्याक्षो हतः, and probably belongs with the nominative dual pair, not the killing. Keep existing marker(s); optional explanatory note: “ಈ ಕಥೆಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಇವರಿಬ್ಬರೂ ದಿತಿಯ ಪುತ್ರರು (7.1.16–18; ಭಾಗವತ 6.18.11). ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಮುದ್ರಿತ ಪದವಿಭಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಖಚಿತವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ.” No independent Mudgala Sanskrit witness.

first_reference_review.receipt:
resolved
0774, folio 4: first complete line after numbered 28. Native conjunct after किंचि includes द्भ, matching dependent transcription lines 280–281. Printed किंचिद्भवेन्न is not draft किंचिद्वेन्न. Split भवेत् + न; scope is back to दुर्लभं, not forward to तं देवम्. Next verse confirms that she undertakes austerities.
Kannada candidate: ತಪಸ್ಸಿನಿಂದ ಸಾಧಿಸಲಾಗದದ್ದು ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲವೆಂದು ವೇದವು ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನಾನು ಆ ದೇವನನ್ನು ತಪಸ್ಸಿನಿಂದ ಆರಾಧಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ.

first_reference_review.receipt:
resolved
0776, folio 6: line between closing 14 and 15 (native crop includes the first half). The conjunct and final letters favor ह्युत, not draft हृत; corroboration lines 413–414. याचिता is feminine and can refer to Pārvatī herself (implicit अहम्); previous verse has Śaṅkara seek her from her father, with the earlier request explicitly for marriage at 7.2.46. No abduction verb. The Kannada question preserves the rhetorical contrast without changing the actor.
Kannada candidate: ಶಂಭು ನನ್ನನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹೋದನೇ? ಮತ್ತೊಮ್ಮೆ ನನ್ನನ್ನೇ ಕೇಳಲಿಲ್ಲವೇ? ಈಗ ಅವನು ನನ್ನ ಅಧೀನದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾನೆ; ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂದೇಹವಿಲ್ಲ.

contextual_rechecks.receipt:
partial
Verse 6 introduces differentiated second Brahman, v7 has a locative absolute (त्वन्मायया … परेशे … मिलिते), and v8 follows with the generation of so'ham and bindu. This sequencing rules out identifying so'ham and bindu as the two parties who first unite in v7; their own union is v9. [Likely Desai Marathi 7.9.7–9](https://www.transliteral.org/pages/z120205203031/view) likewise reports mutual joining before so'ham/bindu and does not supply an unambiguous named antecedent at v7. Attach Gaṇeśa's presence free of delusion to तत्र स्थितस्त्वम्, not to Pareśa. Keep exact ⟦ಅಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ⟧ for the unexpressed other party or parties.

partial
0789, folio 19: following 10, एवं (right edge) and full next line show परेशाधिपतेन सृष्टं. Transcription lines 1365–1366 agrees. Instrumental of the title is secure; whether the title has a precise technical identity and what exactly was made remain uncertain. Frame the actor as a title, not a named deity. Use singular impersonal creation wording without inventing its object.
Kannada candidate: ಹೀಗೆ ಪರೇಶಾಧಿಪತಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ⟦ಅಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ⟧ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಯಾಯಿತು. ಗಣರಾಜನೇ, ಹಾಗೆಯೇ ನೀನು ನಮಗೆ ಪ್ರಕಾಶಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವೆ. ವೇದಗಳು ನಿನ್ನನ್ನು ಸಾಂಖ್ಯಸ್ವರೂಪನೆಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತವೆ. ಆ ವಿಘ್ನರಾಜನನ್ನು ನಾವು ಸದಾ ಭಜಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

contextual_rechecks.receipt:
partial
K9.1.25 and K9.5.66–79 independently within the work characterize Sāṅkhya as an emanated form and as witness-like, without arising of its own, contrasted with bodha and not a declaration that Gaṇeśa is himself created. Retain concrete title Pareśādhipati without replacing it by a named deity. [The Marathi retelling](https://www.transliteral.org/pages/z120205203031/view) does not give a secure separate object for सृष्टम् and its “न” in the vicinity of भासत cannot be imported into Sanskrit नो (here “to us”). Sāṅkhya is securely what the Vedas call Gaṇeśa's manifestation; the technical identity of the creating title and the exact supplied noun for सृष्टम् not secure. Preserve ⟦ಅಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ⟧.

contextual_rechecks.receipt:
partial
K7.9.4 places the all-pervading bimba in a cosmogony of sat/asat duality, and K7.10.17 calls Vighneśa bimbātmaka, supporting an image/form in which he abides. [Likely Desai Marathi 7.10.6](https://www.transliteral.org/pages/z120205203115/view) construes the sat-form as mirrored in the two māyās, but does so via an explicit verbal expansion not expressed by Sanskrit बिंबेन. Do not invent a second creation or rewrite the damaged spelling; retain ⟦ಅಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ⟧ in the draft.

first_reference_review.receipt:
partial
0791, folio 21: final full line of body, after 6 and before the beginning of 8. Original confirms स्वतः परत उत्थानं and nasal spelling बिंदुकम्; transcription lines 1552–1553 agrees except normalized बिन्दुकम्. Lexical sense ‘arising from oneself / from another’ is clear; no fixed correspondence of each with so'ham and bindu without more context. Preserve the terms.
Kannada candidate: ಅನಂತರ ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರೂ ಒಂದಾಗಿ ಎರಡು ವಿಧವಾದ ಉನ್ನತ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದರು. ಒಂದು ತನ್ನಿಂದಲೇ ಉದಯಿಸುವುದು, ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಮತ್ತೊಂದರಿಂದ ಉದಯಿಸುವುದು. ಅನಂತರ ಸೋಽಹಂ ಮತ್ತು ಬಿಂದು. ಇವುಗಳ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಸಂಬಂಧ ⟦ಅಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ⟧.

contextual_rechecks.receipt:
resolved for working Kannada
The flagged mapping can be replaced by the actual sequence rather than made to imply a one-to-one correspondence. Clear intra-work parallel K9.5.48, .63–64 defines स्वत उत्थान as bodha's own arising; .66–77 discusses परत उत्थान in Sāṅkhya. K9.1.9 and .25–28 distinguish Sāṅkhya/bodha, then so'ham and then bindu, while K7.9.8–9 already treats so'ham and bindu as a pair preceding the fourfold world. K9.3.104, .106 places both so'ham and bindu in a discussion of the self-arising aspect, so assigning the two outcomes one each to स्वतः and परतः by their order would overstate the Sanskrit. The second ततः in K7.10.7 signals the next step, and K7.10.8 adds another ततः for the fourfold world. Preserve both Sanskrit technical names; close the Kannada marker on the connection as a sequence, not on speculative metaphysical causation. Kannada: “ಅನಂತರ ಆ ಎರಡೂ ಸೇರಿ ಎರಡು ಬಗೆಯ ಉತ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿದವು: ತನ್ನಿಂದಲೇ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಉತ್ಥಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಪರದಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಉತ್ಥಾನ. ಆ ಬಳಿಕ ಸೋಽಹಂ ಮತ್ತು ಬಿಂದು ಪ್ರಕಟವಾದವು.” No Sanskrit normalization or attributed lineage change.

Totals: five contextual revisits, one resolved for working Kannada, four remain partial. None adds first-comparison coverage.
